title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - GaiaX
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/GaiaX. Top level element of the Gaia-X ecosystem. The source documentation declares no own properties for this class and marks it abstract, not intended for direct instantiation; included here per the full-ontology translation scope.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'GaiaX'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.
